subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Stormy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Serene**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Stormy **means involving a lot of angry argument and strong feeling. (क्रोध और तीव्र भावनाओं से युक्त; संकटपूर्ण)

 
 
• Example -* The **stormy **note was back in his voice.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Serene **means calm and peaceful. (शांत और अविक्षुब्‍ध या गंभीर)
 
 
• Example -* He remained **serene **in the midst of turbulence.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that '**Stormy**' and '**Serene**' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 3.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Ferocious **means very aggressive and violent. (अति आक्रामक और हिंसक; उग्र व ख़ूनख्‍़वार)
 
• **Sporadic **means not done or happening regularly. (अनियमित)
 
• **Rough **means violent, not calm or gentle. (उग्र; शांत या कोमल नहीं, रूखा)
